Found the bug! On line 303:

```html
<v-tab vvalue="free_date">Individuelles Datum (Freitext)</v-tab>
```

The attribute is `vvalue` (typo with double `v`) instead of `value`. This is a typo that breaks the tab. Because of the typo, the tab doesn't have the `value` attribute that Vuetify needs to match it with the `<v-window-item value="free_date">` on line 348.

The user mentioned the label as "individuelles Datum (freitextfeld)" but the file has "Individuelles Datum (Freitext)" — close enough, this is clearly the same UI element.

```html
<v-tab vvalue="free_date">Individuelles Datum (Freitext)</v-tab>
```

Typo: `vvalue` instead of `value`. The `value` prop is what Vuetify uses to match the tab to its `<v-window-item value="free_date">` at line 348. With the typo, the tab never activates that window item, so the `<v-text-field>` for `selection.custom_date` is never rendered.

parts.text:
Confirmed: the typo was introduced in `8d3b4f0 feat!: migrate to vue 3 and vuetify 3`. In the previous version (`3b2f541`), the tab had no `value` attribute at all (Vuetify 2 default behavior), but the migration to Vuetify 3 changed the tab to have `vvalue` (a typo).

Note: the user wrote "freitextfeld" in the issue but the file has "Freitext" — same element, just slightly different wording in the bug report.

Plan: one-character fix.

## Plan

**Root cause:** `src/components/events/EditAttributes.vue:303` has `vvalue="free_date"` (typo, double `v`). The first `<v-tab>` correctly uses `value="dates"` and works. Without the correct `value` prop, Vuetify 3 cannot match the tab to the `<v-window-item value="free_date">` at line 348, so the `<v-text-field>` bound to `selection.custom_date` never mounts.

**Regression source:** Introduced in `8d3b4f0 feat!: migrate to vue 3 and vuetify 3` (Vuetify 2 didn't need explicit `value`; Vuetify 3 does).

**Fix:** Change `vvalue` → `value` on line 303.

```html
- <v-tab vvalue="free_date">Individuelles Datum (Freitext)</v-tab>
+ <v-tab value="free_date">Individuelles Datum (Freitext)</v-tab>
```

**Verify:** Click the "Individuelles Datum (Freitext)" tab — the freitext text field for `custom_date` should appear. Also confirm the dates-tab still works and saving an event with `free_date` selected still clears `dates` and persists `custom_date` (logic in `onSave`, lines 156–160, is unaffected).

Run `bun run type-check && bun run lint` after the edit.

One character change. Ready to apply when you exit plan mode.
